tei:div.tei:p: 47) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi tshogs mchod ye shes sprin phung bzhugs: 48) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

sku gsum ye shes lha la 'dud: rim gnyis lam spyod rnal 'byor gyis: lhag pa'i lha yi dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i thabs: tshogs mchod ye shes sprin phung bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: mchod pa'i yo byad bkod legs dang: bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs gang 'os: māṃ sa dza gad la sogs pa: bza' ba g.yas dang bdud rtsi g.yon: gang 'os ri rab rol mtsho'i tshul: legs bsham sa spos me rol mo dang*/ lha yi ting 'dzin ldan pa'i ngang: snyan ba'i dbyangs kyis 'di ltar brjod: dang po byin gyis bslab pa ni: hrīḥ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: tshogs 49)kyi dri ma nyes skyon ma lus sbyangs: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsir byin brlabs pas: ngo bo bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi la: rnam pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ru zhu: rab 'byams rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan bdun gyis brlabs: gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings gsang chen rol pa nas: phrin las lhun grub rdo rje phur pa'i lhaḥ yab yum sras 'khor khro bcu za gsod dang: khra thabs sgo skyong dbang mo nyer brgyad sogs: ma lus gnas 'dir tshogs la spyan 'dren 50)gshegs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum rdo rjair smin pa dang: mchog thun drag po mthu yi dngos grub stsol: badz+ra ku mā ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang byung rnam dag bhan+dha'i nang: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: zhen med rang grol ngang du bzhes: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hiḥ bzhi pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings rnam dag gzhong pa ru: sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med: rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor rgyun:

bla med gsang ba'i rdzas chen po: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'di: rdo rje phur pa'i lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: lnga pa bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs: bdag cag ma rig sgrib dbang gis: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs dang ni: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: dag cing tshangs par mdzad du gsolaḥ oṃ 51)ga ṇa tsakra satwa āḥ drug pa nyams pa bsgral ba niḥ hūm̐: srid pa e yi hom khung du: ma rig gnyis 'dzin rū tra yi: dbang yul phung khams skye mched kun: ye shes lnga yi phur pas btab: 'gugs 'ching sdom myos phyag rgya bzhis: ma rig gnyis snang ru tra bsgral: khams gsum sku gsum klong du sgrol: nyon mongs gnas dag ye shes dbyings: rnam shes chos sku'i klong du bstim: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs shā truṃ mā ra ya e hur thuṃ dza rbad sod: bdun pa zhal bstab ni: bdag rtog gnyis snang bsgral ba yi: gzugs phung sha khrag don snying bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du bstab: mnyam nyid bde chen ngang du bzhes: 'khrul mi shes pa'i sa ru drongs: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na la khā hi: brgyad pa drang ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje phung po'i grong khyer du: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor lhar: bza' bca' btung ba yang dag rdzas: dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog: tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la ho sid+dhi hūm̐: dgu pa lhag skyong ni: pheṃ bh+yoḥ sngon tshe dpal 52)chen spyan snga ru: khas blangs lhag skyong ma mo'i tshogs: 'dod yon tshogs lhag 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: gang bsam 'dod don yongs 'grub mdzod: uts+tshiṣa ṭa ba ling ta khā hi: bcu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: bzhengs shig rdo rje phur pa'i lha: chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la:

bstan dang bstan 'dzin la gnod pa'i: log 'dren bdud bgegs dam sri rnams: mngon spyod drag po'i mthu yis sgrol: khyad par rgya 'dre 'gong po dang: smon log dam sri gdug 'dre'i dpung: mtha' 'dre kla klo rdul du rlog: rgyal bstan dar rgyas yun brtan cing: 'od gsal gsang ba chen po yi: bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams: zhabs brtan tshe 'phrang rkyen sol la: phrin las phyogs kun khyab par mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel ye shes lha: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcu gcig pa chad tho btang ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe sku gsum rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas rdo rje'i tha tshig bor: bka' sdod dam can sde dang de 'khor 'bangs: 'dir gshegs chad don dmar gyi gtor ma longs: rim gnyis 53)bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas pa dang: bstan 'din tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: g.yar dam ji bzhin las rnams thogs med sgrubs: khyad par phur pa sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyi: bka' dang tha tshig gnyen po dran mdzod la: las bzhi'i phrin las 'bad med lhun grub cing: drag po mthu yi dngos grub thob pa dang: don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin phrin las mdzod: bcu gnyis pa brtan skyong ni: ma bh+yo: dpal chen che mchog pad+ma thod phreng gi: bka' dam la gnas bod skyong brtan ma ni: ma mo bcu gnyis sprul pa yang sprul bcas: 'dir gshegs bshal chu dpal gyi gtor ma bzhes: zab gter bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas pa dang: bstan 'dzin tshe srings bdud sde'i dmag dpung bzlog: phung byed mtha' mi dbus su ma gtong bar: bod khams sems can bde la 'god pa dang: phrin las rab 'byams lhun gyis grub par mdzod: bh+yo ma ma hring hring dzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bcu gsum pa bro mnan ni: hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: log par 'dren pa'i dam sri kun: gru gsum 'bar ba'i hom du 54)mnan: sku gsum ye shes bro rgyas btab:

nam yang ldang med phyag rgyas mnan: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: de nas mchod bstod bya zhing: bcu bzhi dngos grub ni: hūm̐: spros bral 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings: lhun grub rang gsal dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje'i ye shes rol pa'i gar: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis: gsang gsum mi zad dkyil 'khor nas: 'gyur med sku dang 'gags med gsung: 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: mchog tu rig 'dzin rnam bzhi dang: thun mong grub pa brgyad la sogs: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus kun: sgrub mchog bdag la bstsal nas kyang: sgo gsum bum pa'i snod du bskyil: lhun grub phyag rgya chen po'i sa: da lta nyid du thob par stsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hrīḥ ces brjod lce dbang oṃ du gsal: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi myong: 'bral bu sku gsum thob par mos: bco lnga pa nongs pa bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag bag med 'khrul dbang gis: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: cho ga 55)ma dag 'chal tshig sbags: brnyas dang bag med dbang gis ni: nyes par gyur gang bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ sa ma ya: āḥs ma ya: hūṃ sa ma ya: oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs/ āḥ bcu drug pa bsngo smon ni: hoḥ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa yi: dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang sdug bsngal las bsgral te: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi: go 'phang mchog la 'god nus shog: bcu bdun pa bsdu ldang ni: hūm̐: thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: 'od gsal chos sku'i klong du āḥ mkha' las 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang: rtsa sngags/ badz+ra kā wā tsi āḥ bco brgyad pa bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ mnyam nyid gdod nas rnam par dag: chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog:

rang gsal ma 'gags lhun gyis grub: mtha' bral longs sku'i= 'dzin med rang grol kun tu khyab: thugs rje sprul sku'i= gzhi 'bras gnyis med ngo bo nyid: 56)mi 'gyur rdo rje'i bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: las rjes mi mngon gsang bar bya: sa ma ya: e ma theg mchog gsang ba snying po yi: lam gyi cha lag zab mo 'di: mkhar chen ḍā ki mtsho rgyal ngas: gces nor tshul du sa ler gtad: da lta ma spel gter du sbos: ma 'ongs nyi shu kha ral dus: mdo khams du ba sngon pos khyab: de dus nga yis byin brlabs pa'i: yos sam 'brug lo su kha'i ming: de dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gror sman: a tsar sprul pa'i grogs dang ni: chos bdag skyes bu rim lnga ni: mai tri seng ha'i sprul pa mchog: shes rab mig ldan cang shes 'dzin: lho nas badz+ra ming mtha' can: dpal dbyangs sprul pa sa man+ta: dpral bar sme ba nor bu'i ris: mi ring nye ba'i gnas nas 'ong: sna nam khye'u chung zung sprul pa: mche ldan sngon mo'i lto bar snyan: badz+ra ming can las 'phro ldan: gzhan rkyen sap+tas ma bsgribs na: gter gnyis bstan pa de la dbang: lang 'gro'i sprul ba shar nas 'byung: grol ming 'dzin pa ma nges spyod: dgongs gter snyan brgyud chos la dbang: chos 'di'i bstan pa de yis 'dzin: nam snying bai ro'i sprul pa ni: ngur mo'i lo 'dzin shes rab ldan: las kyi ming 'dzin dus su 'phrad: g.yu sgra snying dang dpal ye shes: 'o bran dbang phyug la sogs pa'i: sprul 57) pa chos kyi bdag po ni: karma'i ming dang rgyal gyi mingaḥ grol dang don gyi ming 'dzin dang: ak+ṣa ra yi ming 'dzin gsum: blo ldan ḍā ki'i rigs can rnams: las dang smon lam dbang gis ni: lho dang lho ru brgyud nas 'phradaḥ smon log dam sri'i rkyen bskul nas: gser thag g.ya' yis ma gos na: gter gnyis bstan pa rim gyis dar: nad mtshon mu ge 'khrugs rtsod zhi:

'gro khams bde zhing bstan pa 'phel: 'di don stabs ka gzab gal che: pradzñā dharma rat+na dang: bde dang rgyal gyi ming 'dzin gsum: rten 'brel dus su 'dzom gyur na: chos brgyud de yis 'dzin par nges: dus la bab tshe gtad rgya phrol: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum dang: srog gi spu gris thub par srungs: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sbas rgya: gter rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang skyes mchog dam pa ak+ṣa ra badz+ra gyis bka' bskul spyi bor son tshe gtad rgya btsan thabs kyi tshul du sad pa la brten nas kun bzang chos nyid bde skyong dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o//
